card.name: No clear shared pattern
card.fires_on: Scattered words with no shared setting: the letter Z inside a brand name, the word 'in' after 'born free' or 'inequalities', and odd words like 'are', 'So' and 'Middle'.

modes.label: Inside a brand name
modes.description: A letter partway through a capitalized drug brand name.
modes.example: limit sun exposure during and for 2 months after treatment with LA<<Z>>CLUZE in combination with amivantam

modes.label: The word 'in' after a noun or verb
modes.description: The word 'in' linking a person or noun to a place or quantity in biography or news text.
modes.example: Fidel’s experience as a lawyer made him extremely critical of the great inequalities<< in>> wealth that existed in Cuba.
